_meta.rescope_note:
RQ2.d (iteration on failure modes) was rescoped to future work in thesis
Section 7.2.3 after the decision to use a single-round evaluation. The
catalog produced from this manifest records observations only; no
iteration has been performed. Each entry's recommended_iteration field
describes what future work would do.
_meta._warning: survey/qualitative_themes.yaml present but contains no coded confusion_patterns yet; qualitative observations will be empty until manual coding completes.

_disclosure.intended_use: Failure observations are reported as evidence that the MVE evaluation framework can systematically surface problems. Per thesis Section 7.2.3, addressing these is future work.

TECHNICAL_LAYER_1.name: Layer 1 too technical for non-technical roles
TECHNICAL_LAYER_1.description:
MVE Layer 1 (the WHY layer) uses jargon or feature names that
non-technical operators (nurses, biomed engineers) cannot parse.
Operationalised as low SHAP-feature surface rate in Layer 1
(all_3_present in rq2_mve_shap_alignment.json) and as qualitative
themes mentioning vocabulary/jargon.
TECHNICAL_LAYER_1.impact_metric: User study confidence score (RQ2.c per-role confidence)
TECHNICAL_LAYER_1.recommended_iteration:
Simplify vocabulary post-Mode-A generation; map raw feature names to
role-appropriate phrasings (e.g., 'fwd_pkts_tot' → 'outbound data
volume' for nurses). Re-run alignment metric to verify SHAP features
still surface in simplified form. Round 2 evaluation required.

evidence.summary: fusion_class=BENIGN (n=16): only 0% of alerts surface all 3 top SHAP features in Layer 1 (threshold 50%). Proxy for Layer-1 jargon/vocabulary gap.

MITRE_NOT_REFERENCED.name: MITRE technique not referenced or not understood
MITRE_NOT_REFERENCED.description:
Layer 1 fails to reference the mapped MITRE technique (T-ID or human
name), or references it without sufficient context for the reader to
understand what it means.
MITRE_NOT_REFERENCED.recommended_iteration:
Add plain-language gloss alongside T-IDs (e.g., 'T1071 (command-and-
control communication)'). Strengthen Mode A prompt to require both
T-ID and human name. Re-run grounding metric.

DO_NOT_IGNORED.name: DO_NOT clinical-safety actions ignored or under-emphasized
DO_NOT_IGNORED.description:
Layer 3 DO_NOT constraints (e.g., 'do not disconnect ventilator')
are present but not visually emphasized; operator overlooks them in
study or skips the constraint when reporting action_taken.
DO_NOT_IGNORED.impact_metric: User study accuracy on CRITICAL+clinical-device alerts (RQ2.c per-role accuracy)
DO_NOT_IGNORED.recommended_iteration:
Visual emphasis in UI for DO_NOT (red badge, separate block, required
acknowledgement before submission). UI change, not generator change.
Re-run study with new UI.

ROLE_VIEW_MISMATCH.name: Role view inappropriate for participant background
ROLE_VIEW_MISMATCH.description:
A participant assigned a role view (per self-selection or assignment)
reports the explanation didn't match their actual operational mental
model — or two participants in different roles disagree about what
the alert means despite a shared anchor.
ROLE_VIEW_MISMATCH.impact_metric: User study per-role differentiation (RQ2.c per-role accuracy gap)
ROLE_VIEW_MISMATCH.recommended_iteration:
Better role inference at study signup (e.g., short skill survey
instead of self-selection). For deployment: integrate with hospital
identity provider to derive role from job title. Re-run study with
better role assignment.

OTHER.name: Unclassified failure observations
OTHER.description:
Observations that do not fit the four fixed categories. The size of
this bucket is itself diagnostic — if it is large or growing across
runs, the taxonomy needs revision.
OTHER.recommended_iteration:
Triage each entry. If a pattern emerges, propose a new fixed
category for the next iteration of the taxonomy.
